identity_check_limit: Title and DOI/PMID relationships checked; complete author lists, every journal field, all numerical table entries, registry histories, and correction/retraction status were not exhaustively reaudited.
pubmed_lookup_limit: The PMC identifier converter did not map every DOI; that is not evidence of an invalid DOI. PubMed records and registration-agency metadata supplied the identity checks.

selected_claim_checks.checked: Primary text agrees with 19 laboratories, 617 recruited, 531 complete datasets, 525 in the unseen-trial analysis, accuracy .552 with a one-sided interval, and overall detection sensitivity above zero.
selected_claim_checks.scope: Selected methods/results checked in the first 40,000 body characters; remaining text and supplements not exhaustively inspected.

selected_claim_checks.checked: Primary abstract and body support the conditional indirect-task advantage in three of six participants; the awareness-task sensitivity assumption and variation across timings remain explicit.
selected_claim_checks.scope: Body retrieved in two segments; selected relevant results inspected, not raw data or every analysis.

selected_claim_checks.checked: The primary comparison table confirms ISF minus control perceived-flicker difference 3.4 with 95% CI 2.7–4.1, alongside SNR difference 4.3 with CI 3.4–5.3. The technique label does not establish zero visibility.
selected_claim_checks.scope: Body retrieved in two segments; selected comparison table and surrounding methods/results inspected.

selected_claim_checks.checked: Primary text supports 30 adults, sleep-stage evoked responses, a powered but optically blocked control, unblinded experimenters, and fixed condition order. These endpoints do not test semantic comprehension.
selected_claim_checks.scope: Body available in one retrieval; selected methods and results inspected.

selected_claim_checks.checked: Primary abstract and retrieved text explicitly criticize post hoc lowest-visibility selection and distinguish sensitivity from response bias; this is a methodological argument, not a blanket refutation of every positive result.
selected_claim_checks.scope: Abstract and first 40,000 body characters; full argument and supplements not exhaustively rechecked.

selected_claim_checks.checked: PubMed identities match the Jimenez 2026 model-comparison article and the Hernandez-Gutierrez 2025 systematic review/reanalysis. They remain editorial leads, with no recovered mapping to turn3file2.
selected_claim_checks.scope: Metadata/abstract identity and role; not new full-text verification of every underlying result.

access_label_policy: FT/PFT/A and prior search/inspection statements in the four supplied artifacts describe their reviewer, not a claim that this intake independently read every full paper. Newly retrieved body segments and selected checks are separately enumerated.

link_audit.new_access_limit: The supplied Meyen author PDF returned HTTP 503. Its DOI and PubMed alternatives remain available as identity routes; a transient failure is not a missing study.

transformations: Public derivatives prepend provenance, retain substantive supplied content, convert three repository self-links in the full review to local navigation, and normalize extra blank lines at EOF in three files. Recorded link and newline transformations are reversed for original-byte verification. The proposed wiki file remains a supplied proposal; the topic page is the editorial adoption.
conceptual_clarification: Correct meaning choices already demonstrate objective content access; the further claim can concern subjective experience or an indirect/direct sensitivity comparison under explicit assumptions.
